$comment: Agent state: the backlog and its status. One feature is 'in_progress' at a time. Update `status` and `evidence` in the same change that lands the work — never ahead of it. See CLAUDE.md > Definition of done.

features.name: Fix the dangling keyboard-navigation roadmap link
features.description: packages/react-gantt/README.md:502 says the widget is 'not yet keyboard-operable — see [Roadmap](#1-keyboard-navigation)', but the Roadmap section has no keyboard-navigation entry; #1 is Critical path. Either restore a keyboard-navigation roadmap entry or retarget the link. Decide which, don't silently drop the accessibility caveat.
doneCriteria: No link in packages/react-gantt/README.md points at a heading that does not exist in that file
The a11y section still states plainly that pointer-only affordances are not keyboard-operable
pnpm format:check passes on the file

features.name: Critical path (CPM) analysis and highlighting
features.description: Layer critical-path analysis on the dependency graph already built by buildDependencyGraph in packages/react-gantt/src/core/scheduling.ts. Compute the longest zero-slack chain, expose a `highlightCriticalPath` option, and surface an ownerState flag so critical bars and links can be styled through the existing slot API. Roadmap item 1 in packages/react-gantt/README.md.
doneCriteria: Slack is computed from working time, not calendar days (ADR-006 — lag is working time)
`highlightCriticalPath` defaults to off; charts that do not set it render byte-identically to today
Critical bars and links expose an ownerState flag; no new hardcoded colors outside the CSS custom properties in packages/react-gantt/src/index.css
Unit tests in packages/react-gantt/src/tests/core/ cover: a linear chain, a diamond (two parallel branches, one critical), a chain crossing non-working time, and a graph with no dependencies
A new ADR records the slack definition and what was rejected
docs/glossary.md gains 'Slack' and 'Critical path' if those terms enter the code
./init.sh passes

features.name: Export and print mode
features.description: Export the chart to PNG/SVG/PDF, plus a print render mode that temporarily disables virtualization and renders the full extent so the browser's print pipeline captures every row. Roadmap item 2 in packages/react-gantt/README.md.
doneCriteria: Print mode is opt-in and scoped to the render pass; it never mutates task data
Un-virtualized rendering is bounded or explicitly documented as O(rows) memory — a 100k-row print must fail loudly, not hang the tab
Exercised against the 100k-row example in apps/docs and the apps/playground large-dataset generator
An ADR records why virtualization is bypassed rather than made print-aware
./init.sh passes

features.name: Keyboard operation of the grid and bars
features.description: The widget's ARIA structure is complete (treegrid + grid, absolute aria-rowindex under virtualization) but bar move, resize, progress and dependency creation are pointer-only, and are deliberately aria-hidden with tabIndex -1 rather than advertised as controls no key can activate. Making them keyboard-operable means giving each a real key handler and then un-hiding it. Blocked on a decision about roving tabindex vs. an application-mode grid.
features.blockedBy: No decision yet on the focus model (roving tabindex across a virtualized treegrid vs. application mode). Write that ADR before writing code — it determines nearly every other choice here.
doneCriteria: An ADR fixes the focus model before implementation starts
Focus survives virtualization: scrolling a focused row out of the window must not silently drop focus to body
Every affordance un-hidden from the a11y tree is genuinely operable by key
The a11y section of packages/react-gantt/README.md is updated to match reality
./init.sh passes

features.name: Clear the pre-existing format:check failure
features.description: `pnpm format:check` fails on packages/react-gantt/README.md as of commit 8d4c65c (docs: update roadmap). Unrelated to any feature work, but it makes ./init.sh red on a clean checkout, which trains agents to ignore the gate. Fix with `pnpm format`, review the diff, and land it on its own.
doneCriteria: pnpm format:check exits 0 on a clean checkout
The diff is formatting only — no prose changed
